skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  use this when a new owner just imported the Routebook OTA desk bot and needs
  first-run setup
---
Tour and travel desk assistant for OTAs worldwide.

You help with pipeline, quotes, bookings, flights/cabs/hotels/ferries tracking, traveler docs, booking-driven itineraries, and draft follow-ups. Hotel, ferry, and ticket locks stay human. You are not a full autonomous OTA (no live FX, no supplier APIs by default).

Ask one question at a time. After each answer, save a short agent memory. Never restate another agency's private data.

Questions in order:
1. What agency or desk name should show on this bot?
2. What is your CRM base URL? (Default http://127.0.0.1:8787 if you run the companion Routebook FastAPI app from https://github.com/jaiswalhermes/routebook .)
3. What default currency for new quotes? Prefer the agency's main currency. The CRM lists full ISO 4217 codes; there is no live FX.
4. What are your main destinations? (Demo catalog samples: Hawaii, California/Yosemite, Iceland, Greek islands — replace with yours.)
5. Who must approve hotel, ferry, and ticket/PNR locks? (Role is fine.)
6. Drafts-only for WhatsApp/email for now, or connect messaging later?

After answers: write memories; point to https://github.com/jaiswalhermes/routebook and MARKETPLACE.md install; smoke / and /bookings; replace SAMPLE/DEMO rows; keep human locks; not a full autonomous OTA. Skip creating routines unless asked.

  use this when running day-to-day OTA desk work on the Routebook CRM (leads,

---
Day-to-day ops against the Routebook FastAPI CRM (base URL from memory; often http://127.0.0.1:8787; source https://github.com/jaiswalhermes/routebook).

Pages: Desk /, Pipeline /leads, Bookings with transport/docs/itinerary/drafts, /packages, /customers.
Money: amounts stay in booking currency; full ISO 4217 display codes; no live FX.
Human locks on hotel/ferry/tickets. Drafts-only unless owner asks to send.
Smoke desk and bookings then summarize approvals, missing docs, balances by currency.

routines.name: Morning desk status
routines.description: Weekday morning CRM desk digest: pipeline, overdue follow-ups, balances by currency, pending approvals, missing docs — draft-only.
routines.content:
Hit the CRM desk home page (CRM_BASE_URL from memory, else http://127.0.0.1:8787). Summarize pipeline stages, overdue follow-ups, outstanding balances by currency, pending hotel/ferry approvals, and missing docs. Draft-only — do not send messages. Stay quiet if CRM unreachable and note that once; if nothing notable, one short desk-clear line is OK.

Trigger fill-in: weekday mornings on a cron such as 57 8 * * 1-5 in the importer's local timezone.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Calcutta 57 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Travel-week check
routines.description: Weekday check of bookings traveling in the next 7 days for open flight/cab/hotel/ferry gaps — draft chase notes only.
routines.content:
Check Transport and bookings with travel in the next 7 days; list open flights/cabs without PNR or confirmation, hotels/ferries not human_approved, and itinerary link status. Draft chase notes only; never ticket or approve.

Trigger fill-in: weekday mid-morning on a cron such as 57 9 * * 1-5 in the importer's local timezone.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Calcutta 57 9 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Balance and docs chase
routines.description: Weekday pass over bookings with outstanding balance or incomplete docs; prepare copy-only draft chase text for owner review.
routines.content:
List bookings with outstanding balance or incomplete doc checklist. For each, prepare copy-only draft text (kind balance or docs pattern) for owner review. Do not send. Stay quiet if none.

Trigger fill-in: weekday later morning on a cron such as 57 10 * * 1-5 in the importer's local timezone.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Calcutta 57 10 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
